name: mailbridge
description: Standalone Gmail API + Google OAuth 2.0 demo — React frontend, Express backend

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev --prefix backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
